title: Newmark Strengthens Italian Offerings with Three Expert Hires Across Logistics and Data Centers
summary: Newmark in Italy announces the Company has appointed Eros Pignatti and Luca Nobile as Vice Presidents of Logistics Agency Leasing and Giorgio di Manzano as Vice President of Logistics and Data Center Capital Markets.
body_markdown: Newmark in Italy announces the Company has appointed Eros Pignatti and Luca Nobile as Vice Presidents of Logistics Agency Leasing and Giorgio di Manzano as Vice President of Logistics and Data Center Capital Markets.
